headline: 10 units deployed as fire rages in Chawkbazar multi-storey building
summary: Firefighters are struggling to control a blaze at the Munsur Khan Plaza in Old Dhaka, hampered by narrow lanes and a lack of water sources.
details: A massive fire broke out at the Munsur Khan Plaza, a multi-storey building in the Choto Katara area of Chawkbazar, Old Dhaka, on Monday afternoon.
The blaze started at a shop on the sixth floor of the building at approximately 5:02 PM.
Ten units from the Fire Service and Civil Defence, including teams from the headquarters and Lalbagh fire station, are currently working to bring the fire under control.
Firefighters faced significant challenges due to theabsence of natural or permanent water sources in the congested area.
Rescue workers are attempting to extinguish the fire by pulling hose pipes from a distance and using water-carrying vehicles.
As of now, there have been no reports of casualties or the exact cause of the fire.
caption:
10 fire units are battling a massive blaze in Old Dhaka's Chawkbazar. Narrow lanes and water shortages are hindering the effort.

A massive fire broke out at the Munsur Khan Plaza, a multi-storey building in the Choto Katara area of Chawkbazar, Old Dhaka, on Monday afternoon.

The blaze started at a shop on the sixth floor of the building at approximately 5:02 PM.

Ten units from the Fire Service and Civil Defence, including teams from the headquarters and Lalbagh fire station, are currently working to bring the fire under control.

Firefighters faced significant challenges due to theabsence of natural or permanent water sources in the congested area.

Rescue workers are attempting to extinguish the fire by pulling hose pipes from a distance and using water-carrying vehicles.

As of now, there have been no reports of casualties or the exact cause of the fire.
